events.title: Broadbeach Beats
events.description: An outdoor community music event held in the Broadbeach Mall, featuring local performers in an open-air public setting. Expect a relaxed atmosphere suitable for a casual stroll or sitting to enjoy the live tunes.

events.title: Tommy Memphis
events.description: A live performance by Tommy Memphis at the SOPO club, known for a repertoire of classic hits and popular covers. This is a standard club-style gig perfect for those looking for an evening of live entertainment.

events.title: Live Music at The Grand Hotel
events.description: A recurring live music session at The Grand Hotel in Labrador, showcasing regional artists and musicians. It provides a local pub atmosphere for enjoying live performances.
